prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
answer_verbatim:
For a small business, **Otterly.AI** looks like a good starting point: it’s relatively affordable (reported plans start around **$25–$29/month**) and tracks whether your business appears in answers from ChatGPT and other AI search tools. You can monitor prompts customers might actually ask, such as “best plumber in [city]” or “where can I get [service] near me?”

If **local, city-by-city visibility** is your main concern, take a look at **Local Falcon** as well; it offers geo-targeted tracking of how ChatGPT refers to businesses across a service area.

Before paying, try a free snapshot such as **HubSpot’s AI Search Grader**, then check that any paid plan lets you track your own prompts and locations. Treat results as directional, not a guarantee: AI answers can vary by wording, location, and time, and no tracker can prove exactly what every customer sees.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
